items.title: Sheryl Bailey interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, July 24, 2023
items.q: We saw Ella and we saw Andre Previn, we saw Mel Torme, you know whoever that was

ctx.x: Well said. Was there a particular artist and even beyond that a particular LP that put you on the jazz path?

Yeah, well you know I’m from the Pittsburgh area and there was a radio station back when you had way more independent radio stations, WYEP, and they had all kinds of — it was public access radio. And you know I just listened to all kinds of things there. And I turned it on and I heard Sonny Rollins. And then I heard Charlie Parker. And then I heard Wes Montgomery. And then I just was hooked. It was an addiction from there. So then I started — my mother actually — at the time I was playing in a rock band and my…
Yeah. Did you have to go out and then get a different kind of guitar?
